findings.evidence: Line 259-265: statement is `g (eikonalCurrent g (K.elasticLegs eLepton eHadron) ℓ) ℓ = 0`; the separate-line fact is `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine_conserved` at line 216, used in the proof.
findings.fix: Keep the bullet to what the theorem states and give the per-line claim its own bullet naming `eikonalCurrent_chargedLine_conserved`.
findings.issue: Module docstring bullet for `eikonalCurrent_elasticLegs_conserved` adds "and so does each of its lepton and hadron parts separately"; the declaration (line 259) states only `g (eikonalCurrent g (K.elasticLegs …) ℓ) ℓ = 0` for the whole current.

findings.evidence: EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:32-45 — fields `p, pPrime, k, kPrime, q` with only `hq : q = k - kPrime`; `pPrime` doc: "For inclusive DIS this field can be carried as background data." grep for `elastic` in that file returns no constraint.
findings.fix: Say that these are the legs of a process with one charged lepton line and one charged hadron line, and that reading them as elastic scattering assumes `K` is elastic (`pPrime` the outgoing hadron, `pPrime = p + q`); note that the conservation results hold regardless.
findings.issue: `elasticLegs` is documented as "The charged legs of elastic lepton–hadron scattering", but nothing constrains `K.pPrime`: `DisKinematics` carries only `hq : q = k - kPrime`, and its `pPrime` field is documented as possibly "background data" for inclusive DIS. The definition applies to any `DisKinematics`, elastic or not.

summary: Documentation is otherwise complete and free of process narrative, but the module docstring attributes a stronger claim to `eikonalCurrent_elasticLegs_conserved` than the theorem states, and `elasticLegs` is documented as elastic kinematics although `DisKinematics` imposes no elasticity relation.
